card.name: the application DRPC
card.role: records the request and drives both sites

def.what: The hub control record for one protected application.
def.creator: The DR administrator enrolls the application.
def.reader: Ramen on the hub, and the DR console.
def.where: On the hub, in the application DR namespace.
def.analogy: A job ticket that says what should happen and how far it got.

card.name: the primary site manager
card.role: turns one application into per disk work orders

def.what: The per-site manager for a protected application's disks and objects.
def.creator: Ramen creates it from the DRPC.
def.reader: Ramen, and anyone reading DR status.
def.where: On the spoke, in the DR namespace.
def.analogy: A site foreman who turns one job ticket into individual work orders.

card.name: one work order per disk
card.role: gives one disk its replication role

def.what: The request that gives one disk its replication role.
def.creator: The VRG creates it for each protected claim.
def.where: On the spoke, beside the VRG.
def.analogy: One line item on the foreman list.

card.name: the group switch
card.role: one request for a whole volume group

def.what: One request that controls a whole volume group instead of one disk.
def.creator: The VRG creates it when the policy uses group replication.
def.where: On the spoke, beside the VRG.
def.analogy: One switch for a whole rack instead of one switch per machine.

card.name: the handle holder
card.role: stores the group handle and the volume map

def.what: The object that stores the array group handle and the volume mapping.
def.creator: csi-addons creates it while reconciling the group replication.
def.reader: csi-addons, when it calls the driver.
def.where: On the spoke, owned by the group replication.
def.analogy: The key card that matches a locker number to its owner.

card.name: DeleteVolumeGroup
card.role: removes a group from the array by handle

def.what: The CSI call that deletes a volume group from the storage array.
def.creator: A CSI driver implements it.
def.reader: csi-addons calls it while deleting a group object.
def.where: Between the cluster and the array.
def.analogy: The only form the storage desk accepts to close a locker account.

card.name: DisableVolumeReplication
card.role: ends the copy on one session

def.what: The CSI call that stops replication for one disk or group.
def.creator: A CSI driver implements it.
def.reader: csi-addons calls it when replication objects are deleted.
def.where: Between the cluster and the array.
def.analogy: Cancelling the courier route, not the parcels.

def.what: Removing DR for an application while the application keeps running with its data.
def.creator: The DR administrator, from the console, the CLI or YAML.
def.reader: Ramen, which removes the DR objects on both sites.
def.analogy: Cancelling the insurance policy, not selling the house.
